face.name: 晶石魔像
face.text: 嘲讽。复生。亡语： 为你的英雄恢复 3点生命值。
face.flavorText: 萌萌的护卫。

face.name: Crystalline Golem
face.text: Taunt, Reborn Deathrattle: Restore 3 Health to your hero.
face.flavorText: Cute'tut Defender.

face.name: 光沐元素
face.text: 嘲讽。亡语：&为所有友方角色恢复 8点生命值。
face.flavorText: 气象节目说，外面的天气可以洗澡了。你带好了伞，发现是日光浴。

face.name: Lightshower Elemental
face.text: Taunt Deathrattle:& Restore 8 Health to all friendly characters.
face.flavorText: The forecast calls for light showers, but you won’t need an umbrella.

face.text: Taunt Deathrattle:& Restore 8 Health to all friendly characters.
face.flavorText: The forecast calls for light showers, but you won’t need an umbrella.

face.name: 硬壳甲虫
face.text: 亡语：&获得3点护甲值。
face.flavorText: “好了，你的队伍打败了那只甲虫。”“我要把它放在头上。”“什么？”“我要把它戴在头上，像帽子一样。”

face.name: Plated Beetle
face.text: Deathrattle:& Gain 3 Armor.
face.flavorText: "Ok, your party has defeated the beetle." "I put it on my head." "What?" "I put it on my head. Like a hat."

face.name: 泰兰·弗丁
face.text: 嘲讽。圣盾。亡语：&抽取你的法力值消耗最高的随从牌。
face.flavorText: 泰兰和血色十字军一同度过了人生中的多数时光，最终发现，这伙人也许算不上好人。

face.name: Taelan Fordring
face.text: Taunt, Divine Shield Deathrattle:& Draw your highest Cost minion.
face.flavorText: After growing up with the Scarlet Crusade for most of his life, Taelan finally realized they were maybe not the nicest people.

face.name: 腐心树妖
face.text: 亡语：&抽一张法力值消耗大于或等于（7）点的随从牌。
face.flavorText: 腐烂到心里去了。都怪萨维斯！

face.name: Rotheart Dryad
face.text: Deathrattle:& Draw a minion that costs (7) or more.
face.flavorText: Rot through the heart and Xavius is to blame!

face.name: 寒冬先锋
face.text: 亡语：&抽一张冰霜法术牌。
face.flavorText: 寒冬：它先请。

face.name: Harbinger of Winter
face.text: Deathrattle:& Draw a Frost spell.
face.flavorText: Winter: it be comin'.

face.name: 拾箭龙鹰
face.text: 战吼：&抽牌，直到你拥有三张手牌。
face.flavorText: 不会计较你脱靶了多少次。

face.name: Arrow Retriever
face.text: Battlecry:& Draw until you have 3 cards.
face.flavorText: And he'll never tell how many times you missed.

face.name: 巴拉克·科多班恩
face.text: 战吼：&抽取法力值消耗为（1），（2）和（3）点的法术牌各一张。
face.flavorText: 他们都说他是马背上的神射手。

face.name: Barak Kodobane
face.text: Battlecry:& Draw a 1, 2, and 3-Cost spell.
face.flavorText: They say he's a pro at horseback archery.

face.name: 馆长

face.flavorText: 年久失修的馆长，脾气也变得十分古怪。

face.flavorText: The Curator guards Azeroth’s deadliest creatures, but it’s secretly terrified of squirrels.
